jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise data platform capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions that support business, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Gather customer and stakeholder feedback to identify platform enhancements, emerging needs, and innovation opportunities.
* Create and manage product backlogs, requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive adoption of modern data engineering practices and cloud-native platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with data scientists, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure data platforms support AI and machine learning workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform product strategy and investment decisions & Define measurable business outcomes and monitor product performance against established objectives.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership & Support planning, prioritization, and execution of platform modernization initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in in Product Management, Technology, Data Platforms, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and modern platform architectures & Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale technology or data platform products.
* Experience working with large-scale data processing, data integration, analytics, or data platform solutions.
* Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or similar distributed processing frameworks.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms, data lakes, metadata management, or data governance solutions.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts and AI-enabled business capabilities & Experience supporting products, platforms, or solutions used for analytics, machine learning, or generative AI workloads.
* Ability to define product requirements that enable AI-ready data assets, model development, or data-driven decision makin & Familiarity with modern AI ecosystem concepts such as MLOps, feature engineering, model lifecycle management, or AI governance.
* Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI-enabled capabilities & Knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or related AI technologies.

  
  
  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

The CCB Data & Analytics team responsibly leverages data across Chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers. The team encompasses a variety of disciplines from data governance and strategy to reporting, data science and machine learning. We have a strong partnership with Technology, which provides cutting edge data and analytics infrastructure. The team powers Chase with insights to create the best customer and business outcomes.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. **Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

We are seeking a seasoned, highly skilled and motivated Product Manager to be part of the product focused on creating solutions that provide ServiceNow with a competitive advantage in platform and AI technologies. The Product Manager will be at the forefront of the exciting new AI Space of AI Agents. The ideal candidate will have experience in a technical product capacity or as traditional product with a background in building products with a keen interest in AI and Innovation. This is an exciting and innovative opportunity for the right candidate. Expertise with AI Products, ServiceNow platform and the ability to translate complex requirements into functional solutions will be critical in driving successful outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strategic: Develop Roadmap and feature prioritization for AI Agent Platform
* Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in AI and platform technologies. Provide informed recommendations and insights to PM leadership.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work on cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and AI research, to develop and launch new PoCs.

* Innovation: Passion for innovation and technology with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive and hands-on approach. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

 **Job Description**

The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team to leverage their deep understanding of India regulatory requirements and expectations to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in India.

This hands-on first line of defence (1LOD) role will involve working closely with product teams in APAC and globally to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.

**This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:**

* Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product and regulatory requirements and risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
* Regulatory and financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of trends and the regulatory agenda in India, identify, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
* Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group, and ensure Wise Product teams are aware of the most recent regulations and guidance.
* External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

**This role will give you the opportunity to:**

* Grow your hands-on Fintech knowledge at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
* Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.
* Be empowered to identify problems and opportunities, and take a lead in the solution design and implementation.

**About you:**

* Expert in regulatory and financial crime compliance and risk management in India, with 10+ years experience in financial services (banking, fintech or consulting) and a deep understanding of the expectations of local regulators/policymakers.
* High levels of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify improvement opportunities or areas of elevated risk, prioritise, and drive work from inception to completion at pace with limited oversight. This includes anticipating risks and roadblocks, and demonstrating resilience to work through them.
* Problem solving attitude, with the ability to not only analyse and interpret complex regulatory and risk management frameworks, but to exercise sound judgement in proposing and implementing customer-centric and scalable solutions, using data to drive decision-making and quantify risks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with different audiences (from Product & Engineering teams to external auditors and regulators such as the RBI).
* Strong collaboration skills, to work effectively with different stakeholders globally (such as Product, Risk and Compliance), and to influence without authority.
* Challenge the status quo, thinking outside-the-box and questioning how we can achieve an optimal balance of achieving compliance whilst delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
* Previous experience working directly with product and engineering teams, including effectively translating regulations into actionable business requirements.
* Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
* Legally authorised to work in India or Singapore.

**Nice to have but not essential:**

* Previous experience in working in a fintech or a similar fast-paced environment.
* Previous experience working with a PA-CB and/or ADII licensee.
* Experience working in cross-border teams.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Mobile Apps
jobs.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
  
  
The Senior Product Manager is one of the key roles in shaping the company’s digital transformation as it evolves from a hardware-driven to a software-led organization.
  
  
The position holds global responsibility for development of WSA’s consumer hearing aid mobile application, which represents the primary interface between the company and hearing aid wearers.
  
  
This role ensures that the mobile app drives measurable consumer engagement, supports commercial growth, and strengthens brand positioning through digital innovation and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
The incumbent operates with a high degree of autonomy, guiding cross-functional team and influencing business direction across global markets.
  
  
In addition to commercial ownership, the role includes direct leadership of a small, international product team operating across India and Europe. Serve as a cultural connector, promoting effective collaboration between Western and Indian business environments.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Product Leadership**

* Define and execute the long-term vision and strategy for the consumer application in the WSA ecosystem, aligned with corporate digital transformation goals.
* Translate market dynamics, user insights, and technological trends into a differentiated app strategy and product roadmap.
* Provide product leadership across functions, balancing innovation, commercial priorities, and feasibility.

**Commercial and Analytical Ownership**

* Drive the commercial evaluation of digital initiatives, including business case development, ROI assessment, and financial forecasting.
* Ensure that app initiatives are supported by robust performance metrics and consumer feedback loops.
* Leverage and steer consumer data and analytics to shape feature priorities, drive retention, and optimize lifetime user value.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the primary interface between business, engineering, and market teams, translating strategic intent into deliverable software solutions.
* Collaborate closely with R&D and software engineering teams, particularly with Indian development partners, ensuring effective global collaboration and delivery alignment.
* Partner with marketing, UX, and commercial teams to ensure end-to-end product excellence and regulatory compliance.

**Global Scope and Influence**
Represent the voice of the global consumer across markets, ensuring the product experience resonates across cultures, languages, and regulatory environments.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Education & Professional Background**

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in product management, ideally in digital health, consumer tech, or connected device industries.
* Strong understanding of software engineering processes, agile methodologies, and lifecycle management from a commercial standpoint.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

* Proven experience managing data-driven consumer applications.
* Strong analytical mindset, with ability to synthesize market data, user analytics, and financial insights.
* Expertise in commercial planning and business case development for digital products.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed global organization.
* Experience working with or leading teams in India or collaborating with Indian software partners.
* Multilingual proficiency and experience working across multiple cultures preferred.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic and conceptual thinker with strong execution drive.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High integrity, cultural awareness, and adaptability in a global context.
* Passion for improving the end-user experience through digital innovation, whether in app or through use of app data.

Who we are
  
  
At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.
  
  
*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

jobs.title: Sourcing & Product Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**Role overview**

We are a growing consumer products business with a portfolio spanning Kitchen & Dining, Small Home Appliances, Seasonal Home Appliances and Home Furnishing. We are looking for a practical, commercially minded professional to manage sourcing, product costing, supplier terms and quality assurance from development through production.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

Product sourcing and development

- Identify and assess manufacturers and suppliers across the relevant product categories.

- Coordinate product development from initial brief and sampling through approval and production readiness.

- Build a dependable supplier base that can support new launches and business growth.

  

**BOM costing and cost optimisation**

- Prepare detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs) and establish target costs for new and existing products.

- Break down component, raw material, packaging, manufacturing and logistics costs; identify savings without compromising quality.

  

**Commercial negotiations and terms of trade**

- Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, advance payments, MOQs, lead times and volume-based discounts.

- Agree clear terms for tooling, packaging, freight, warranties, replacements, defective goods and other relevant commercial conditions.

- Improve supplier terms in ways that support margins, cash flow and dependable supply.

  

**Quality assurance**

- Set up quality checks for sample approval, pre-production, in-process manufacturing and pre-dispatch stages.

- Create product-specific specifications, inspection checklists and acceptance criteria.

- Coordinate supplier audits and inspections, investigate recurring defects, and ensure corrective actions are completed.

- Use customer reviews, returns and complaints to identify product issues and improve future batches.

  

**Supplier performance management**

- Review suppliers on cost, quality, capacity, delivery performance and commercial flexibility.

- Track performance against agreed standards, address recurring issues and develop alternate sources where appropriate.

  

**Launches and continuous improvement**

- Coordinate specifications, samples, costing, testing, packaging and production readiness for new launches.

- Benchmark competing products and use consumer feedback to improve existing products.

- Confirm products meet approved cost, quality and commercial requirements before production commitments are made.

  

**Qualifications and experience**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality or a related discipline.

- Around 3-5 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, product development or quality, ideally in consumer products.

- Experience in one or more of these categories: Kitchen & Dining, Small Home Appliances, Seasonal Home Appliances or Home Furnishing.

- Working knowledge of BOM costing, manufacturing processes, supplier negotiations and quality-control methods.

- Experience negotiating payment terms, credit periods, MOQs and other terms of trade.

- Strong Excel and analytical skills; experience with factory audits, inspections, defect analysis and corrective actions is an advantage.

- Willingness to travel to supplier and manufacturer locations as required.

  

**What success looks like**

- Products sourced at or below agreed cost targets.

- Improved supplier payment terms and working-capital efficiency.

- Fewer quality defects, returns and repeat customer complaints.

- Consistent use of inspection standards and documented corrective actions.

- New products ready for launch on time and within approved cost and quality parameters.

- Reliable suppliers with measurable performance on quality, cost and delivery.

  

**The person we're looking for**

Someone who is comfortable working directly with suppliers and manufacturers, pays attention to the details behind product cost and quality, and follows issues through to resolution. The role needs a balance of commercial judgement, structured quality checks and hands-on execution.

Within GDI&A, the Industrial System Analytics (ISA) team partners with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Program Management, and Product Development teams to solve complex business challenges and drive measurable business value.

We are seeking an experienced Data Science and Analytics Leader who combines strong analytical expertise with product thinking, stakeholder engagement, and delivery leadership. This role will lead the development of new analytics and AI solutions from concept through deployment by collaborating with business stakeholders, data scientists, software engineers, data engineers, and product teams.

**Description**

As a Manager within Industrial System Analytics (ISA), you will lead the creation of next-generation analytics and AI solutions that help optimise Ford's manufacturing operations, supply chain, quality, cost, and product development processes.

This role is ideally suited for someone who has a strong foundation in Data Science and Machine Learning and has successfully partnered with business leaders to identify opportunities, translate business problems into analytical solutions, and deliver products that generate measurable business outcomes.

You will play a key role in shaping new products from the ground up, including defining requirements, evaluating data ecosystems, influencing technical direction, building cross-functional teams, and driving successful adoption across global business functions.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on, data-fluent **Technical Product Owner – Product Analytics & Telemetry** to serve as the single source of truth for our product performance, user adoption, and platform utilization.

In this role, you won't just manage a backlog, you will dig directly into complex datasets across Databricks, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, WalkMe, and Datadog to quantify the real-world impact of our Jira initiatives. You will bridge the gap between engineering telemetry, product instrumentation, and business strategy, building the dashboards and executive narratives that dictate our roadmap investments.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Multi-Source Telemetry Extraction:** Query, blend, and analyze data across diverse infrastructure layers—including Databricks Delta Lake, Snowflake, relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-app workflow telemetry (WalkMe), and operational logs (Datadog).
* **Lakehouse Dashboards & Visualization:** Architect and maintain high-performance Databricks SQL dashboards and visualizations to track cohort adoption, funnel drop-offs, feature utilization, and user retention.
* **Initiative Quantification & ROI:** Map downstream user telemetry directly back to Jira initiatives and epics. Measure feature rollout velocity against actual adoption metrics to validate product bets.
* **Executive Storytelling & Roadmapping:** Synthesize raw analytical outputs into structured, executive-level presentations that highlight adoption bottlenecks, quantify platform usage, and drive prioritization.
* **Telemetry Governance & Instrumentation:** Partner with core engineering and data platform teams to define event taxonomies, tracking specifications, and governance standards, ensuring features launch with production-ready telemetry.
* **Exploratory Data Discovery:** Conduct proactive cohort and behavioral analyses to discover untapped user behavior, navigation friction, and platform optimization opportunities.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **3–6+ years** of hands-on experience in Senior Product Analyst, Product Analytics, or Analytics Engineering within a modern SaaS/cloud environment.
* **Advanced SQL:** Proven mastery of complex SQL (window functions, recursive CTEs, query optimization, handling semi-structured JSON payloads) across relational (PostgreSQL) and distributed data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake).
* **Cross-System Data Fluency:** Practical experience pulling or stitching disparate product data from application logs, clickstream tools, guidance software (WalkMe), and cloud storage (e.g., Azure Blob, S3).
* **Databricks Expertise:** Strong familiarity working natively within the Databricks ecosystem (Databricks SQL, Lakeview dashboards, Delta tables).
* **Product Acumen & Agile Delivery:** Solid understanding of modern product management frameworks, Jira project/initiative hierarchies, and KPI definitions (DAU/MAU, activation rates, cohort retention).
* **Executive Communication:** Exceptional ability to build clean, persuasive decks and clearly present technical findings to non-technical leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Educational or applied background in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Analytics Engineering.
* Working knowledge of PySpark, Python for data manipulation, or dbt.
* Experience operating within cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and understanding Delta Lake architecture.
* Experience defining user event tracking frameworks from scratch (e.g., event naming conventions, schema contracts).

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

* Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,

* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team is seeking an experienced program manager to lead program(s) focused on transporter safety in the Amazon Geospatial domain. In this vertical, we drive initiatives by partnering with various teams in Last Mile to improve Amazon map data and to identify and mitigate risk factors concerning on the road driver safety using geospatial data.  
  
An ideal candidate for this role has solid program management skills and is eager to develop them further. S/he has the ability to implement and maintain processes and mechanisms to effectively support program execution. S/he should be comfortable with data analysis, assisting in process improvements, and helping to standardize procedures under guidance. The candidate should be able to identify issues within current systems and contribute to resolving them.  
  
This job requires good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while also managing tasks independently. The successful candidate will be capable of addressing logistical challenges, show initiative in problem-solving, and demonstrate a strong commitment to completing projects and delivering results.  
  
The ideal Program Manager will be detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple priorities effectively. S/he should be proficient in using project management tools and be ready to learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies in the world of geospatial data.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Own the Program, define and achieve KPIs; Drive performance improvement initiatives.
* Develop and monitor program metrics to identify potential issues in last mile deliveries.
* Identify patterns of defects that will help us build initiatives to reduce defects at scale.
* Ability to pull data and perform deep-dives and root-cause analysis as needed.
* Lead initiatives to identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to reduce defects and improve the delivery experience for Amazon customers.
* Very good communication, both verbal and written to regularly provide business updates during weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews.
* Communicate with stakeholders to share regular updates, resolve blockers and deliver programs/initiatives on time.
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed and ensuring service requirements are met.
* Must be able to systematically escalate problems to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.

  
About the team  
The Last Mile Analytics & Quality (LMAQ) team is part of the Last Mile Tech team and works on improving Geospatial data, Route Quality, and support the driver lifecycle programs. We run programs to identify and reduce defects through manual audits, and leverage data and anecdotes to identify opportunities and closely collaborate with Tech, Science and Product teams to improve our products at scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**BUSINESS ANALYST-Risk Domain | Banking and Financial Services**

**Job Title**

  

Business Analyst - Risk Domain

  

**Function**

  

Risk Management / Business Analysis

**Experience**

  

6-20 years, including 4+ years in risk or financial services

**Role Purpose**

  

The Business Analyst will act as the bridge between risk stakeholders, business teams, data teams, and technology delivery teams. The role is responsible for translating risk-management objectives and regulatory or policy requirements into clear business requirements, process designs, data rules, functional specifications, and testable outcomes. The analyst will support the delivery and enhancement of risk platforms, controls, reporting, and decision-support capabilities across the project lifecycle.

**PRIMARY RISK COVERAGE**

* Credit risk and counterparty credit risk
* Market risk, liquidity risk, or operational risk
* Risk data, controls, regulatory reporting, and model workflows

  

**CORE BA DELIVERABLES**

* Business requirements and user stories
* Process maps, data mappings, and functional specifications
* UAT scenarios, traceability, controls, and stakeholder sign-off

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Business Analysis and Requirements Management**

* Engage risk, finance, compliance, operations, product, data, and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, controls, and expected outcomes.
* Elicit, analyze, document, prioritize, and validate business and functional requirements using workshops, interviews, document reviews, and process walkthroughs.
* Create business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, decision tables, and requirement traceability matrices.
* Assess current-state processes and systems, define future-state workflows, identify gaps, and recommend practical improvements.

  

**Risk Domain and Regulatory Change**

* Support initiatives covering credit, counterparty, market, liquidity, or operational risk, based on project scope.
* Interpret risk policies, methodologies, control requirements, and regulatory change impacts in partnership with subject-matter experts.
* Translate risk concepts such as exposure, limits, collateral, ratings, probability of default, loss given default, expected credit loss, stress testing, and capital or liquidity measures into implementable requirements where applicable.
* Maintain alignment between business rules, risk calculations, reporting outputs, governance expectations, and audit evidence.

  

**Data, Reporting, and Controls**

* Define data requirements, source-to-target mappings, data quality rules, reconciliations, lineage, exceptions, and control points.
* Collaborate with data architects and engineering teams to validate data availability, definitions, transformations, and report logic.
* Support design and enhancement of risk dashboards, management information, regulatory reports, workflow queues, alerts, and exception monitoring.
* Investigate data or reporting issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the relevant teams.

  

**Delivery, Testing, and Change**

* Work with product owners, project managers, architects, developers, vendors, and QA teams throughout Agile or Waterfall delivery.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning inputs, requirement walkthroughs, dependency tracking, and change-control assessments.
* Prepare test scenarios and expected results, support system integration testing and user acceptance testing, manage defects, and obtain business sign-off.
* Create process guides, training material, release communications, and handover documentation; support implementation and post-release stabilization.

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or a related discipline.
* 4-8 years of business analysis experience, with meaningful exposure to banking, financial services, risk management, or regulatory transformation.
* Proven ability to produce high-quality requirements, process models, user stories, data mappings, test artefacts, and stakeholder presentations.
* Working knowledge of at least one risk area: credit, counterparty credit, market, liquidity, operational, enterprise, or model risk.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and managing requirements from discovery through implementation.

  

**Technical and Analytical Skills**

* Strong SQL and data-analysis capability; ability to investigate data using Excel and interpret large or complex datasets.
* Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with process and requirement tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of relational data, data lineage, data quality, APIs, system interfaces, and batch or workflow processes.
* Ability to convert quantitative risk logic and business rules into clear functional requirements and test cases.

  

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Basel framework, IFRS 9 / expected credit loss, stress testing, capital adequacy, liquidity risk, limit management, collateral, or regulatory reporting.
* Risk measures and concepts such as PD, LGD, EAD, RWA, VaR, sensitivities, exposure profiles, CVA, and scenario analysis, depending on role scope.
* Financial products including loans, derivatives, securities, treasury products, and related risk lifecycles.
* Risk governance, internal controls, audit evidence, issue management, and model or data change processes.

  

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Clear, structured communication with the ability to simplify complex risk and technology topics.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* High attention to detail, analytical thinking, ownership, and a control-oriented mindset.
* Ability to …

**Technical Business Analyst III**

Are you a seasoned Technical Business Analyst with a passion for transforming complex financial systems into streamlined, high-performing solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and finance, turning business challenges into smart, scalable IT innovations? If so, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in a globally connected, SAP-driven financial closing environment — and leave a lasting mark on how the world's (re)insurance industry reports its financials.

**About the Role**

As a
**Technical Business Analyst**

, you will sit at the heart of our global financial closing ecosystem, acting as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and our SAP-based platform. You will not only maintain and enhance a sophisticated financial subledger solution, but you will also champion simplicity, standardization, and innovation. From shaping new functionality to validating, it through rigorous testing and live production runs, your fingerprints will be on every improvement we make. You'll engage continuously with a global user community — educating, aligning, and supporting teams across time zones and disciplines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Collaborate with global stakeholders**

  to capture business objectives and requirements, translating them into pragmatic, effective IT solutions
* **Challenge complexity**

  — act as a champion for standard components and push back on unnecessarily complicated solutions in favor of elegant, maintainable designs
* **Establish yourself as a subject matter expert**

  on SAP systems and financial closing processes, providing trusted guidance and mentorship to stakeholders and team members alike
* **Drive end-to-end system changes and customizations**

  through the full lifecycle — from solutioning and implementation through to testing and go-live
* **Support quarterly close operations**

  including incident handling, process documentation, and continuous improvement of E2E system workflows
* **Engage and educate the global user community**

  on an ongoing basis, ensuring alignment, adoption, and confidence in the platform
* **Validate new and enhanced functionality**

  during both testing phases and productive runs, ensuring quality and reliability at every step

**About the Team**

The
**FPSL Subledger Liability**

team is an international product team made up of experienced professionals with diverse and complementary backgrounds. We provide the platform that enables global and local financial closings under IFRS for (re)insurance contracts. At the core of this platform is a robust SAP solution, embedded within an evolving technology landscape that enriches our data and ultimately produces financial statements for the quarterly finance closing process. We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values expertise, curiosity, and a shared commitment to excellence.

jobs.description:
**Principal Product Manager – Core Intelligence and Optimization**

**Target in India | L7 Individual Contributor**

**About the Job – Principal Product Manager, Core Intelligence and Optimization**

Target’s stores operate at extraordinary scale and complexity. Every day, millions of signals across inventory, workload, space, team member activity and physical environments create opportunities to make smarter operational decisions.

As a **Principal Product Manager for Core Intelligence and Optimization**, you will help shape how Target turns those signals into intelligence.

You will be a senior product thought leader working across Core Intelligence to identify and solve some of Target’s hardest problems at the intersection of **AI, data science, operational intelligence, recommendation, optimization and automation**.

Your role will extend beyond any single product. You will explore emerging opportunities, frame ambiguous problems, incubate new intelligence capabilities and connect products across the intelligence lifecycle—from understanding operational context through recommendation and optimization.

You will influence Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations leaders across the enterprise and help shape Target's evolving approach to intelligent Store systems.

**Core Intelligence Optimization Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Shape long-term product thinking for Core Intelligence and identify emerging opportunities across intelligent systems, AI/ML, recommendation, optimization and automation.
* Develop strong product perspectives on how Target can use operational and physical signals to create differentiated Store intelligence.
* Identify complex, cross-cutting problems where intelligence can create meaningful value for guests, team members and Store operations.
* Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear problem spaces, hypotheses and product strategies.
* Help determine where Target should build reusable intelligence capabilities versus domain-specific solutions.

**Discovery, Experimentation & Incubation**

* Lead discovery for emerging intelligence opportunities that span existing product or organizational boundaries.
* Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX and Operations to explore problems and potential solutions.
* Use simulation, experimentation, prototypes and data to rapidly validate hypotheses.
* Incubate new intelligence capabilities until there is sufficient evidence and clarity to scale.
* Establish measurable feedback loops that connect intelligence and recommendations to operational outcomes.
* Challenge teams to demonstrate value and learning before scaling investment.

**Enterprise Product Leadership**

* Connect intelligence capabilities across products and experiences to create coherent, reusable systems rather than isolated solutions.
* Influence product strategy and investment decisions across multiple Product groups.
* Navigate complex technical, operational and organizational trade-offs.
* Communicate sophisticated intelligence concepts in clear language that enables senior leaders to make decisions.
* Serve as a trusted product thought partner to Product Directors and senior PTUX leaders.

Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.

* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.

* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

Managers – Investigations (RPE) set the direction and culture of their teams within a defined strategy by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals, providing individual coaching feedback sessions and weekly one-on-ones that focus on making Amazon's transportation platforms safer to transact, improving customer satisfaction, monitoring real-time service levels and schedule adherence, and serving as the point of contact for escalated investigation resolution of a supervisory nature.  
  
The incumbent manages a team of L2–L3 Investigation Specialists who conduct risk reviews on drivers and accounts to protect Amazon from fraud, abuse, and account takeover, and who take appropriate actions based on processes, tools, and high-judgment decisions. This is a direct-supervisory role over individual contributors; the incumbent does not manage managers, and the number of reports is determined by their manager.  
  
Operating in an area with established procedures and a predictable workflow, the incumbent provides tactical management, makes sound decisions within the team's defined strategy, and seeks direction and coaching from their manager as they continue to develop their management skills. The key to success in this role is the ability to understand the RPE group's vision and manage the team toward attaining it.

Audit work queues and SLA adherence, and report through Metrics, Service Level Agreements, and Key Performance Indicators. Contribute to forecasting accuracy and the staffing requirements needed to achieve SLAs, partnering with program and leadership stakeholders.

About Amazon Business:  
Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.  
At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.
  
  
The Role:  
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?  
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.  
  
The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.  
  
We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:  
  
1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.  
  
2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
  

* Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
* Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
* Outbound channels — email and push notifications
* Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

  
You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
* Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels

* Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels

* Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
* Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
* Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming launch plan and resolve open dependencies.

* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Relay Product Excellence (RPE) is the human judgment layer of the Relay network, the team that steps in wherever technology and automation stop short. When a carrier's identity can't be confirmed by a model, when a driver's route raises a safety flag, or when a bad actor slips past enforcement, it is RPE that investigates, decides, and acts. Partnering with Relay Safety & Trust, Relay Central, Transportation Financial Systems, Relay Supply Product & Tech, and Yard & Fleet Tech, we protect Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon Relay globally, turning the exceptions that automation can't yet resolve into trusted, defensible outcomes at scale.  
We are looking for a results-oriented, customer-obsessed, data-driven leader who is passionate about innovating and optimizing across people, processes, and technology to build a world-class risk-operations team. The ideal candidate is a leader with a proven track record of inspiring leaders and their teams to deliver big results in an investigation operation environment. They continuously improve operational efficiency through strong prioritization and communication skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity. They foster a culture of innovation — inspiring their org to identify process and technology improvements that complement operational excellence and raise investigation quality. They index high on people development and believe at their core that leaders operate at all levels of an organization. The ideal candidate also demonstrates strong judgment in sensitive, high-stakes casework — they understand how to build defensible investigation standards, develop their managers to coach beyond transactional case closure, and drive decisions that balance false-positive risk against network safety and compliance.  
  
1) Operations: The candidate must drive results in a investigation operation environment, leading their managers and stakeholders to meet operational metrics of quality, productivity, decision accuracy, and service levels. They will own the operation goals for the theft-investigation and identity-verification functions operating under them, owning the end-to-end case lifecycle and ensuring the org delivers accurate, defensible outcomes rather than transactional case throughput.

3) People Leadership: The candidate will lead through a team of front-line managers — creating mechanisms for employee growth and development, enabling their frontline managers, and building succession plans across two layers. They will strike the right balance between effective delegation and staying connected to the floor through multiple channels (manager 1:1s, skip-levels, huddles, open office hours). The candidate must develop their managers' leadership capability and their teams' investigative judgment — coaching the org toward adaptive, evidence-driven decision-making that uncovers root causes and withstands escalation and audit.

6. Serve as a leader and escalation point for case resolution of a supervisory, sensitive, or high-risk nature.

jobs.description:
PhonePe Private Limited
  
  
**Job Description**
**About PhonePe**
PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 400 million registered users. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. In 2017, PhonePe forayed into financial services with the launch of digital gold, providing users with a safe and convenient option to buy 24-karat gold securely on its platform. PhonePe has since launched Mutual Funds and Insurance products like tax-saving funds, liquid funds, international travel insurance, Corona Care, a dedicated insurance product for the COVID-19 pandemic among others.
  
  
**Opportunity:**
PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Product Manager at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our platform and user centric products. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.
  
  
**As a Senior Product Manager, you will:**

* Identify large problem statements and break it down into platform level component designs.
* Scope and phase product building meaningfully over and above standard use cases.
* Translate pod and product strategy into a crisp, annual roadmap and define measurable objectives of a suite of products
* Be the subject matter expert in driving business decisions and fuly understand cost and revenue implications of your product suite.
* Drive annual and quarterly planning and execution cadences across pods.
* Be the thought leader for the product suite and evangelize goals and objectives. Drive alignment across stakeholders by effectively engaging them with data.
* Participate in interviews for PM, APM roles and provide inputs for resource planning across functions.

**What we look for:**

* Excellent communication skills.
* Atleast 5+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development
* Analytical and data driven with the ability to to derive action and make decisions based on large data sets.
* Good with scalable data modeling and abstractions on platform design. Can think over and above traditional use cases.
* Come with a strong point of view on all aspects of the business and balance between a data backed view and ambiguity.
* Is able to own output metrics and impact while balancing priorities across pods.

**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

jobs.title: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager - AI
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.

We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.

.
**What You’ll Do**

* **Find the right problems.**
  Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
* **Own outcomes, not outputs.**
  Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
* **Ship AI products that real operators use.**
  Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
* **Drive adoption across the org.**
  Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
* **Partner deeply with data science and engineering.**
  Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
* **Run rigorous experimentation.**
  A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
* **Stay at the frontier.**
  Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.

**The kind of problems you could own**

* **Network intelligence:**
  demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
* **Last-mile optimization:**
  address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
* **Computer vision on the ground:**
  shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
* **Generative AI and agents:**
  autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
* **Risk and trust:**
  fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
* **Pricing and commercial intelligence:**
  dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization

You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
* A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
* Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required

**Skills**

* Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
* Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
* Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
* Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
* Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments

**Pedigree signals we value**

* Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
* Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
* Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Risk
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.
  
  
You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. Proven ability and in-market examples of defining a strategic vision for a new and innovative portfolio of products that drove significant impact for millions of end users at a global scale
* Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle from planning through deployment; experience leveraging test and validation frameworks throughout the product lifecycle. Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in Agile teams is desirable
* Must have a passion for our sellers and the relentless drive to improve experiences for our sellers, influencing a higher bar on quality and ensuring the seller is always at the center of our product roadmap and priorities. Experience working with design research and qualitative tools to ensure the voice of our seller is at the center of our product development
* Strong, concise communicator and effective story-teller; experience using both analytics and qualitative research to express the vision and strategy of the product
* Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering or Business management.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
**PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL | FINKRAFT.AI**
  
Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head

**ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI**

Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.

The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it.

**THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING**

A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived.

This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN 90 DAYS**

- Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node.
- Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs.
- One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Product Strategy and Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why
* Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions
* Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence
* Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped

Field Ecosystem Engagement

* Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP)
* Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability
* Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs

Ecosystem Integration Ownership

* Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS → GDS/OTA/TMC → Concur/expense tool → bank/payment → Finkraft → GST claim
* Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff
* Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go-live
* Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why

PRD and Engineering Partnership

* Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics
* Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review
* Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria
* Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision

Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration

* Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item
* Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix
* Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room
* Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS

Market and Regulatory Intelligence

* Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates
* Monitor hotel-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates
* Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives?

Requirements
  
  

**REQUIREMENTS**

Must Have

* 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS
* Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews
* Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect
* Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production
* Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand-holding in every stand-up
* Comfort with field-heavy, travel-intensive work across India

Strong Preference

* Has worked directly with Concur, SAP Concur integrations, or competing expense management platforms
