jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
What you'll be responsible for
  
  
You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
* Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
* Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
* Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
* Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
* Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle
  
  
Core requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
* Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
* Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

**Preferred Requirements**

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Manager – Voice AI & LLM Chatbots**
Sense is hiring a Product Manager to own a major part of our Voice AI, LLM chatbot, and Agent Builder roadmap, from strategy and vendor decisions to delivery, quality, and customer outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will work on Sense's conversational AI products and set direction for your area with Product Leadership.
  
  

* Voice AI and AI Receptionist: outbound and inbound agents that screen candidates, collect data, answer questions, and hand off to recruiters.
* LLM chatbots: web and SMS agents built on the same platform.
* Agent Builder: a modular platform (Greeting, Data Collection, Screening, FAQ, Closing) with custom instructions, prompt architecture, ATS variables, testing tools, and publishing into Sense Workflows.
* Voice stack: telephony, speech-to-text, LLMs, and text-to-speech from multiple vendors, where latency, voice quality, and cost per call are product decisions.
* Integrations: ATS field mapping and note writeback, which decide whether a good conversation becomes a usable record.

The work is hard because outputs are non-deterministic, calls happen in real time, and staffing customers run high volumes under consent and compliance rules. You will work in the EPD (Engineering, Product, Design) triad with AI/ML, Customer Success, Implementation, and GTM teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Strategy**

* Own the roadmap and outcomes for one or more areas: voice agent quality and evals, Agent Builder platform capabilities, voice cost and architecture, or ATS and workflow integrations.
* Find where conversational AI can improve recruiter productivity, candidate experience, and outcomes such as screening completion and submission-to-placement conversion.
* Track advances in LLMs, speech models, and voice orchestration, and judge which are worth adopting.

**Execution**

* Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that work for non-deterministic systems.
* Lead prioritization, sprint planning, and release coordination with Engineering, AI/ML, and Design.
* Work with QA on test coverage and run User Acceptance Testing before release.

**Platform and vendors**

* Define agent behaviors, modules, prompt architecture, and guardrails with AI/ML and Engineering.
* Make build-versus-buy and vendor decisions for speech, voice, and LLM components, with cost and quality trade-offs modeled.
* Improve unit economics, including prompt efficiency and cost per call.
* Define call outcomes and classifiers, such as consent revoked, human contact requested, and logical completion.
* Own ATS integration behavior, including field mapping and writeback.

**Quality, evals, and compliance**

* Build the approach to agent quality: call sampling, pre-release simulation, A/B testing, and voice-quality metrics.
* Improve observability so teams can see why a conversation went the way it did.
* Work with Legal and CS on consent, opt-out, and disclosure requirements.

**Customers and stakeholders**

* Run discovery sessions, demos, and roadmap conversations with customers, recruiters, and Implementation teams.
* Triage escalations, spot patterns across support tickets, and turn them into product fixes.
* Support pilots and account health reviews, and present to executives.

**Metrics you'll own**
**Area**
**Example metrics**
Conversation outcomes
  
  
Connect rate, call and chat completion rate, drop-off by module, human handoff rate
  
  
Business impact
  
  
Screening completion, submission-to-placement conversion, recruiter time saved
  
  
Quality
  
  
Evaluation scores, voice-quality measures, interruption and latency quality, issue volume by theme
  
  
Reliability
  
  
ATS writeback success rate, platform and vendor uptime, escalation volume
  
  
Economics
  
  
Cost per call, gross margin per bot, LLM and speech cost per conversation
  
  
Trust
  
  
Opt-out and complaint rates, compliance check pass rate
  
  
Adoption
  
  
Active bots and accounts, time to launch a new bot, customer satisfaction
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must have**

* BE/B.Tech or MBA, with 4–7 years of product management experience. Excellent academics.
* Shipped at least one LLM-powered, voice, or conversational product used by real customers.
* Practical understanding of prompt design, grounding, guardrails, and failure modes of LLM agents.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation approaches for AI or other non-deterministic systems.
* Hands-on experience working with LLM tools such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT, for example through a personal, academic, or work project using LLM APIs, prompts, chatbots, or voice agents.
* Strong analytical skills, including SQL and working with API and integration behavior.
* Good system design skills and knowledge of the software development life cycle.
* Excellent written and oral communication, including executive presentations.
* Ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks, work well in a team, and apply feedback constructively.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with real-time voice systems such as telephony, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
* Experience with enterprise, multi-tenant configuration platforms.
* Exposure to HR tech, staffing, or high-volume candidate engagement.
* Familiarity with consent and compliance requirements for outbound calling and messaging.

**Why join**
You will work on products that talk to candidates at scale, with real customers and measurable outcomes. The team is small enough that you will influence architecture, vendor, and roadmap decisions early. Sense offers active mentorship, learning and development support, and a path to larger product leadership roles.

jobs.description:
**About the company:**

Our mission is that “Any financial application can onboard any user, anywhere in the world, in 1 click.” Transak provides onboarding to financial applications through authentication, KYC, risk checks, and fiat on/off ramps. This is a next generation of infrastructure for the next generation of financial applications that are built on blockchain and stablecoin rails. Our API and widget-based solutions are used by top partners like MetaMask, Coinbase, Ledger, and Trust Wallet to enable seamless onboarding of over 10 million users across over 450 active applications.

We have raised over $37M from top-tier investors including Consensys, Tether, and Animoca Brands.

**Role Description:**

This is a full-time remote role as a KYB Analyst at Transak. The KYB Analyst will be responsible for conducting due diligence on business customers & business , ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and assessing business risk profiles. The role involves verifying corporate documents, identifying Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs), screening entities and associated individuals against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media databases, and escalating high-risk cases for further review. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment with rotational shifts.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or a related field
* Prior experience in KYB / KYC / AML operations is preferred; crypto experience is a plus
* Certification in AML / Compliance (e.g., CAMS) is a plus
* Experience in regulatory compliance, auditing, onboarding, and due diligence of legal entities (LLCs, Corporations, Partnerships, etc.)
* Knowledge of screening users and entities against Sanctions, PEP, and adverse media databases
* Experience in transaction monitoring and alert remediation
* Knowledge of UBO identification and ownership structures
* Understanding of global regulatory requirements for business verification
* Strong analytical and investigative skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail with the ability to analyze complex data and corporate structures
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Business Verification:** Conduct end-to-end KYB checks including verification of company registration documents, licenses, and corporate filings.

**UBO Identification:**Identify and validate Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) and understand complex ownership structures.

**Entity Screening:** Perform sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening on businesses and associated individuals.

**Risk Assessment:** Assess the risk profile of business customers based on jurisdiction, industry, ownership, and transactional behavior.

**Alert Review & Remediation:** Review flagged business accounts and perform enhanced due diligence (EDD) where required.

**Escalation & Reporting:** Escalate high-risk or suspicious entities and support regulatory reporting requirements.

**Compliance & Documentation:** Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for all KYB decisions to maintain regulatory readiness.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, or Business Administration.

* **Skills:** Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze complex data and high attention to detail.

* **Knowledge:** Proficiency in screening users against Sanctions, PEP, and adverse media databases.

* **Mindset:** Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-velocity startup environment.

  

* **Crypto Context:** Prior experience in crypto, payments infrastructure, or Web3 startups.

**Nice-to-Have** :

* **Professional Certification:** AML or Compliance certification (e.g., CAMS) is a significant plus.

* **Elite Education:** Studied at top-tier institutions (e.g., IITs, IIMs, ISB, or equivalent top universities).

* **Technical Literacy:** Comfort with data tools, dashboards, and understanding of API-driven products.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Workday HELP (Case & Knowledge Management)
jobs.description:
The Pitch
  
  
As Product Owner for Workday HELP, you’ll own how our employees get answers and resolve HR issues: the cases, the knowledge, and the agents that make both smarter. You’ll implement, break things in sandbox, decide what ships, and turn Workday’s newest AI features into something employees actually use. This is a hands-on IC role. You will configure, test, and launch, not manage a backlog from a distance. And the exciting part: you will continue your consulting journey as we roll the implementation to our portfolio companies across the globe. Also, Workday is shipping AI faster than most teams can evaluate it. We want someone who gets excited about that, not overwhelmed by it.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Own and implement Workday HELP**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of Case Management: case categories, case types, routing, SLAs, escalation paths, security, and integrations
* Build and run Knowledge Management: article structure, authoring and approval workflows, audience targeting, and content lifecycle
* Own the HELP product roadmap, backlog, and release readiness, including triaging each Workday bi-annual release for what matters to us

**Experiment With What’s Next**

* Evaluate and pilot new Workday AI capabilities as they arrive, including Illuminate and self-service agents
* Run structured experiments: define the hypothesis, configure in sandbox, test with real scenarios, and measure results
* Make clear, evidence-backed recommendations on what to adopt, defer, or skip
* Help shape our agent-led self-service approach, from deflection to guided resolution

**Make it measurable**

* Define the metrics for HR service delivery: case volume, resolution time, deflection, knowledge usage, and employee satisfaction
* Build case analytics and dashboards that show leaders what is working and where to act next

**Work across the Workday ecosystem**

* Partner with Core HCM, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll teams so HELP works smoothly with the rest of the platform
* Work with People Operations, HR Centers of Excellence, and IT on process design, content ownership, and change management
* Coordinate with Workday and implementation partners on features, defects, and early-adopter programs

What You Bring
  
  
**Must-haves**

* Hands-on Workday HELP implementation experience. This is non-negotiable. You have taken Case Management and/or Knowledge Management from design to go-live
* Strong Core HCM background. You understand worker data, business processes, security, organizations, and how HELP depends on all of it
* Experience as a product owner, functional lead, or senior consultant who owns configuration, not just requirements
* Ability to translate HR service needs into clear user stories, configuration designs, and test plans
* Strong stakeholder communication across HR, IT, and business teams

**Strong plus**

* Experience implementing or piloting Workday self-service agents or Illuminate AI features
* Case management analytics experience (Workday reporting, people analytics, or dashboards on case data)

**What Makes You a Top Candidate**

* Experience in Peakon, Learning, or Journeys. We want someone who sees how HELP connects to the wider employee experience, such as a Journey that triggers a case or Peakon feedback that reshapes knowledge content
* Workday certifications in HCM or related modules
* Prior experience in a shared services or global HR environment

You’ll Thrive Here If You
  
  

* Treat every new Workday release like a gift basket and open it immediately
* Are comfortable saying “that didn’t work, here’s why, here’s what we do instead”
* Prefer building and testing over writing 40-page decks
* Care about the employee on the other end of the case, not just the configuration
* Can make a judgment call with 80% of the information

Why This Role
  
  

* To bring HELP to life, hands on.
* Early access to evaluating Workday’s AI roadmap, with real influence on what we adopt
* A role built around experimentation, not maintenance
* Visible impact: every employee touches HELP
* Opportunity to grow into broader People Technology and AI-in-HR leadership as our platform scope expands

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about turning complex data into actionable insights that shape business strategy? As a Business Analyst III at Amazon, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems by combining deep analytical expertise with a thorough understanding of business objectives. In this role, you will own end-to-end analytics solutions — from defining the problem to delivering strategic recommendations that influence long-term decisions. You will partner with cross-functional teams, mentor fellow analysts, and drive continuous improvement across processes and mechanisms. If you are a curious, self-motivated problem solver who thrives on making data-driven impact at scale, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze complex business problems across multiple domains, synthesizing data and business knowledge to generate strategic recommendations that inform organizational decisions and roadmap priorities.
* Design and implement scalable analytics solutions using SQL, spreadsheets, and visualization tools, while proactively identifying opportunities to standardize and simplify existing processes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and technical partners such as Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Scientists to unlock new insights, onboard new data sources, and validate data accuracy.
* Communicate findings and recommendations to leadership through written narratives and verbal presentations, translating granular analysis into clear, compelling stories that drive alignment and action.
* Mentor analysts within your organization by sharing best practices in business analysis, data modeling, and insights generation, while driving operational excellence through process improvement.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing key performance metrics and investigating an unexpected trend, then pivot to a working session with stakeholders to scope a new analytics project. After lunch, you could be writing a narrative document that frames a strategic recommendation for leadership, followed by a peer review of a teammate's SQL code. Throughout it all, you are balancing short-term requests with longer-term initiatives on your roadmap, choosing the right tool for each problem and ensuring your solutions remain scalable.

Our team is committed to using data and analytics to help Amazon make smarter, faster decisions on behalf of our customers. jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

**Role Overview:**

This role will own the analysis workstreams for moderate-to-complex initiatives, aligning cross-functional stakeholders on requirements, process impacts, solution design needs, validation, and business readiness. Potential Initiatives will involve implementing enhancements to existing platforms and/or to implement entirely new platforms. The work will include a broader re-evaluation business processes, the systems and integrations that support them, including modification, replacement, and development of integrations where needed. These initiatives will be delivered within a highly regulated environment, with GxP and validation considerations incorporated throughout.

**Role Scope / Deliverables**

Manage the analysis activities for the integration, migration and functional components of new or existing technical implementation projects, working collaboratively with the broader project team, business SME's, Vendors and other technical resources to proactively identify and assess business needs. Partner with business stakeholders, technical teams, and architects to elicit and document detailed requirements, along with supporting mappings and specifications, ensuring requirements are appropriately maintained within the established change management system. Develop test scenarios and scripts based on integration requirements and coordinate testing activities through completion. The role may also contribute to analysis and requirements activities across the broader implementation.

Success will require a high degree of flexibility and initiative in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with a willingness to adapt to non-traditional or not fully defined approaches while proactively identifying and advancing the work needed to move the project forward. This person will need a strong self-directed mindset to drive their initiatives and project teams to deliver on results and not wait for or require direction from leadership on a daily or weekly basis.

**Key Skills**

* Ability to elicit, analyze, and document clear, detailed, and testable integration requirements, using requirements syntax and structure appropriate for technical integrations.
* Familiarity with common business systems analysis techniques and project delivery methodologies, including both Waterfall and Agile approaches.
* Ability to develop detailed source-to-target data mappings.
* Ability to identify and document error conditions, exception handling, and related integration requirements.
* Experience developing test scenarios and test scripts and coordinating/managing testing activities.
* Working knowledge of integration technologies and concepts, sufficient to collaborate effectively with architects and technical teams.
* Understanding and experience with data migration and data mapping related to system enhancements and replacement as needed.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, with familiarity with **GxP and system validation practices.**
* Ability to work independently and demonstrate initiative while collaborating effectively within a broader project team and with appropriate oversight.
* Proactively evaluate existing business and/or project practices that need improvement and the drive to implement said improvements.
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving environment, including the ability to proactively identify and advance work when the approach is not fully defined.

REQUIREMENTS:  

* Advanced Degree plus 3 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of experience in systems analysis, business requirements gathering, and solution design
* Preferred Fields of Study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or related field

jobs.title: Business Analyst II, Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.  
  
We are looking for a good fit to join our Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning Team, part of the larger Supply Chain Team. This team plays a crucial role in strategically planning and executing Amazon's Last Mile Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. As a Last Mile Business Analyst II, you will be at the forefront of enabling cross-functional teams to evolve our delivery network, continuously analyzing and optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability while maintaining a strong customer focus.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for developing analytical frameworks and capacity models that address both current and future demands, ensuring business continuity even through peak periods. Your analysis will directly contribute to our long-term strategy programs, preparing Amazon's last mile delivery network for sustained growth while striking the delicate balance between delivery speed, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.  
  
You will leverage your expertise in data analysis, long-term forecasting, and capacity modeling to generate data-driven insights that shape the future of our Last Mile operations. This position requires strong analytical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams across the organization. Your insights and recommendations will be instrumental in guiding senior leadership decisions and driving the continuous improvement of our vast delivery network.  
  
As a key member of this team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Amazon's ability to meet and exceed customer expectations in the years to come, playing a vital role in our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.  
  
You are expected to have exceptional analytical, planning, and written/verbal communication skills. You know and love working with business intelligence tools, are comfortable accessing and working with big data from multiple sources, and are enthusiastic about partnering with the business to deliver results. You are a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.  
  
Join our team and help shape the future of Amazon's last mile delivery network, contributing to our mission of becoming Earth's most customer-centric company while balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop and maintain long-term forecasting models for the Last Mile network, focusing on Quarterly Guidance Numbers Validation
* Build and run complex analytical models to predict network capacity requirements 1-3 years in advance
* Partner with cross-functional teams to gather data and insights for accurate long-term forecasting
* Analyze historical data, market trends, and business strategies to refine long-term forecasting methodologies
* Present data-driven insights and recommendations to senior leadership, supporting strategic decision-making
* Support the Plan of Record (POR) planning process through analytical inputs, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial targets
* Identify opportunities for network improvements and cost optimizations through deep-dive analysis of long-term forecasting data
* Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and automated analytical tools to improve forecasting accuracy and visibility
* Develop capacity models for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods
* Contribute analytical frameworks to long-term strategy programs that prepare Amazon's last mile delivery network for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness

  
About the team  
The Long Term Middle and Last Mile Capacity Planning Team strategically plans and executes Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. We unite teams to evolve the network, optimizing cost, speed, and reliability with customer focus. We develop capacity solutions for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods. Our long-term strategy programs prepare Amazon's logistics for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of experience working with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and data visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Excel)
* Experience with forecasting models and capacity planning methodologies
* Experience defining requirements and using data to back up assumptions and drive actions
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders through data-driven insights

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
